headline.title: Gemini 4 Argon 现已上线 AI Gateway
headline.summary: Google 的 Gemini 4 Argon 模型现已在 AI Gateway 上线。它专为编码、代理任务和复杂推理设计，具备 100 万 token 上下文窗口，支持文本、图像、PDF 和视频输入，并支持工具调用。
headline.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon now available on AI Gateway
headline.summary_en: Google's Gemini 4 Argon model is now available on AI Gateway. It is built for coding, agentic work, and complex reasoning, with a 1M token context window, multimodal input (text, image, PDF, video), and tool calling.
